name: evaluation/guide-dataset
description: Requests for complete step-by-step procedures against the evaluation handbook; the router should pick the guide route and subagents should extract each section

input.query: Give me a complete step-by-step guide to install the purifier.

items.expected_output: A numbered installation guide from turning off the water supply to pressing Start.

input.query: Walk me through replacing the filter cartridge step by step, including resetting the counter.

items.expected_output: Disconnect from the mains, replace the cartridge, then hold Reset for 5 seconds.

input.query: Give me a step-by-step maintenance routine covering everything I must do regularly.

items.expected_output: Monthly cleaning, descaling every 3 months, cartridge replacement every 6 months.

input.query: Give me step-by-step instructions to connect the purifier to my Wi-Fi network.

items.expected_output: The handbook does not describe any Wi-Fi connection.
